question: Which of the following methods is a surgical method that is used to prevent sperm transfer from males?
solution:
The correct answer is** Vas deferens is blocked.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vas deferens**

 
 
• The main part of the male reproductive system is the vas deferens, which is also called the **ductus deferens.**
 
• It is a muscular tube-like structure in the **spermatic cord. **The spermatozoa are transported from the epididymis to the ejaculatory ducts through this continuation of the **epididymis.**
 
• In the spermatic cord, the vas deferens is a **45 cm-long **structure that is located medially to the epididymis and posterior to the testis.
 
• The ejaculatory duct is created when it joins forces with the duct of the** seminal vesicle.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Condom**

 
 
• **​**A condom is a **barrier device** with a sheath that is used during sexual activity to **reduce** the likelihood of pregnancy or an** STI.**
 
• Condoms are available for **both men and women**. Women whose partners use male condoms have a 2% annual pregnancy rate when used correctly and at every interaction.
 
• The annual rate of pregnancy with typical use is 18%. The risk of **gonorrhea, chlamydia, trichomoniasis, hepatitis B, and HIV/AIDS **is significantly reduced when they are used.
 
• They also protect against **syphilis, human papillomavirus (HPV)**, and genital herpes to varying degrees.
 
 
 
• **Copper T**
 
 
• **​**Copper-containing intrauterine devices include the intrauterine coil and the** intrauterine device (IUD) with copper**. Copper T is the name given to its** T-shaped** design. Intrauterine devices** prevent pregnancy **by preventing sperm from reaching eggs and fertilizing them.

 Copper T must be inserted by a trained medical professional. Do not attempt to insert yourself.

 Within five days of unprotected sex, it is used for** contraception** and emergency contraception.
 
 
 
• **Fallopian tubes **
 
 
• **​**Through the **uterotubal junction,** the fallopian tube is a pair of thin tubes that connect the **ovaries** of female mammals to the uterus.
 
• The fallopian tubes play a crucial role in the **transportation of gametes**, the process of fertilization, and the embryo's early development, all of which may be affected by a variety of factors that reduce fertility.
 
• The** hollow muscular structure** known as the fallopian tube or uterine tube links the ovaries to the uterus.
